name: worldgym-happy-oyster-bridge
description: Browser bundle of the HappyOyster Web SDK for worldgym/backends/happy_oyster_backend.py

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --minify --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' '--external:*/wasm/reactor_wasm.js' --outfile=happy-oyster.bundle.js && mkdir -p wasm && cp node_modules/@reactor-team/js-sdk/dist/wasm/reactor_wasm.js node_modules/@reactor-team/js-sdk/dist/wasm/reactor_wasm_bg.wasm wasm/
